# Sizing Requirements Checklist: Measurable, self-correcting sizing

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of the telemetry ledger, the tripwires and level promotion, the pre-ready gate and Notion sizing
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Telemetry ledger

- [x] CHK001 Is the (level, phase) bucketing granularity stated for a mid-run promotion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] (a turn lands whole in the level current at its Stop)
- [x] CHK002 Is the source of "phase" defined, including outside an auto run? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions] (run-state `phase`, else `none`)
- [x] CHK003 Are the subagent dedup scope and the missing-meta case both specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is the partial-trailing-line case for subagent transcripts defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Is the report's handling of pre-change ledgers and an empty ledger set defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, US1-4]
- [x] CHK006 Is the privacy boundary (counts only, no text) stated for the new data sources too? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Is a measurable reconciliation between session totals and buckets stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK008 Is a truncated or corrupt ledger or transcript addressed? [Edge Case, Gap] N/A: unchanged behaviour of the existing hook (`readFrom` returns nothing when the file is not past the offset; a corrupt ledger restarts), and FR-004 keeps every failure exiting 0.
- [x] CHK009 Is a latency budget for the Stop hook's added reads specified? [Gap] N/A: no source gives a number (as SC-007); plan Performance Goals require incremental reads only.

## Tripwires and promotion

- [x] CHK010 Is each wire's threshold or path set defined with its value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Assumptions] (FR count > 5, contract paths list)
- [x] CHK011 Is the FR-count threshold referenced from the requirement that uses it? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005] (fixed: "more than 5, see Assumptions")
- [x] CHK012 Are the ceiling (never above 2) and the floor (never lowers) both stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Is the promotion log line's content and no-duplicate rule specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK014 Is behaviour when a wire cannot be evaluated defined and consistent between FR-008 and the edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are the check points in the run order consistent between FR-007, the clarification and US2-7? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK016 Is the proof that owed phases ran defined? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications, Assumptions] (artifacts of `LEVELS[2]`)
- [x] CHK017 Is the level 0 case (no feature directory) specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Pre-ready gate

- [x] CHK018 Are the refusal's exit, PR state and message content specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, US3-1]
- [x] CHK019 Is "one file" defined (exclusions) for the too-heavy mark? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a level 3 feature at the ready step? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-009] (fixed: neither promoted nor marked)
- [x] CHK021 Is rerun idempotence after a refusal specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Is the rule that no level decides test execution stated and bounded? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK023 Is the success criterion for the refusal measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Notion sizing

- [x] CHK024 Is the rule precedence (classifier, boards/brief/points, Bug, unsure) unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK025 Is "filled" for a Build brief section defined, with the missing-heading case? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Is the type of the `Design boards` property (rollup) handled in the facts the requirements read? [Assumption, Spec §FR-011; Plan §Slice 4] (rollup `array` non-empty counts as set)
- [x] CHK027 Is the fallback on Notion failure specified with its output equivalence? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, SC-004]
- [x] CHK028 Is the Story points threshold defined with its value? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 Are Issue types outside the rule table addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Is the "rules only raise" invariant consistent with the Bug rule's level 1 answer? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
